dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Here. While it’s warm.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Thanks, Mira

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Your hands are still shaking. Mine too.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: It'll be ok, they'll stop once we get moving.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I hope you're right.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: How far to the entrance?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Beyond the ridge. There’s some climbing yet.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I can manage.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I know. But you need to rest a bit first.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: You know, there are still people in those houses.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Yeah...but the caravan is going back for another group. They will make it out...I hope.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: And when we leave here, we’re going the other way. It feels like we're turning our back on them.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Maybe...but another surge like that could wipe out the whole valley. We need to reach the source so we can put an end to this.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I'm scared, Mira. We've come so far, but we still have so far left to go.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: It's ok, Caelan, I'm scared too. But I believe in you!

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Mira...I was thinking about the mill.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Halden’s?

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Do you remember when I barely managed to clear that little recess? Would you ever have guessed we'd look back on that as the least of our troubles?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: *laughs* Ha...yeah that seems like a lifetime ago now. But, Caelan?

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: What?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I know what else you're thinking about. I want you to know he's just as proud of you as I am.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: ...thanks. I'm feeling better...lighter.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Your hands stopped shaking. Mine too...I'm ready.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: This lamp...we'll leave it here. Mira, think you can you work your magic with it?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Leave it to me! This beacon will guide the evacuation to safety.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: This should help too.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Ok there! Don't break on me now.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Huh? Me? Or the lamp?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: *smiles* Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Indeed.
